title: Tom's Morning

sentences.text: Tom wakes up at seven every morning.
sentences.trans: 汤姆每天早上七点起床。

sentences.text: He eats bread and drinks coffee for breakfast.
Then he takes the bus to school.
sentences.trans: 然后他坐公交车去学校。

sentences.text: At school, he meets his friend Anna and his teacher.
sentences.trans: 在学校，他见到朋友安娜和老师。

sentences.text: After school, Tom reads a book in the park with his dog.
sentences.trans: 放学后，汤姆和他的狗在公园里读书。

sentences.text: In the evening, the family has dinner in the house.
sentences.trans: 傍晚，一家人在家里吃晚餐。

grammar: 一般现在时第三人称单数加 -s / -es。
时间点用 at，时间段用 in。
